mapper.select: SELECT BD.BRD_NO, BD.BRD_TITL_NM, BD.BRD_CONT, BD.BRD_PBLS_DTM, BD.BRD_VW_CNT, BD.BRD_END_DTM, BD.BRD_DEL_YN, BD.BRD_CTGRY_GRP_CD, MEM.MBR_ID, MEM.MBR_CD, C.CODE_NAME AS BRD_CTGRY_NAME FROM BOARD BD LEFT JOIN MEMBER MEM ON BD.MBR_CD = MEM.MBR_CD LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE C ON C.CODE_GROUP = BD.BRD_CTGRY_GRP_CD WHERE BD.BRD_NO = #{brdNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET BRD_TITL_NM = #{brdTitlNm}, BRD_CONT = #{brdCont}, BRD_MOD_DTM = SYSDATE, BRD_CTGRY_GRP_CD = #{brdCtgryGrpCd}, BRD_END_DTM = #{brdEndDtm} WHERE BRD_NO = #{brdNo} AND BRD_DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE BOARD SET BRD_DEL_YN = 'Y' WHERE BRD_NO = #{brdNo} AND BRD_DEL_YN = 'N'
